end.summary:
Practised how litter, plastic, noise, feeding animals, touching coral, collecting shells, damaging plants, leaving paths and scratching walls harm special places.
Suggested responsible actions such as carrying waste back, staying on paths, not feeding animals, not picking plants or shells, and taking photos instead of damaging places.
Explored how many visitors’ small actions can create a large amount of waste or harm.
Feeding wild animals was discussed several times; Tara continued to suggest feeding them in some situations, so this belief was not corrected by the end.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Tara practised identifying ways visitors can harm beaches, parks and historic places, and gave several useful protection steps, especially carrying waste back, staying on paths and not writing on walls. At home, ask Tara to name three visitor rules and explain why each one protects animals or the place.
